name: What is the step-by-step process for replacing storm-damaged drywall?

mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for replacing storm-damaged drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The replacement process follows four stages: moisture assessment, selective demolition, drying the structural framing, and rebuilding the drywall with finish trim. First, the source of the leak must be stopped. Then, the damaged drywall is cut out at least a few inches above the visible water line to expose the framing. Any damp insulation is removed. Once the wall cavity is fully dry, new drywall panels are hung, taped, mudded, textured, and primed. For complete restoration, baseboards, trim, and interior paint are finished to blend with adjacent rooms.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes stopping the leak, cutting out damaged drywall above the water line, drying framing and removing insulation, then hanging, taping, texturing, and painting new drywall.
